items.headline: New combination cuts risk of death by 58 percent in aggressive lung cancer
items.summary: In a phase three trial published in the New England Journal of Medicine, tarlatamab with durvalumab extended median survival in extensive-stage small cell lung cancer to 21 months from about 13.
items.why_it_matters: Small cell lung cancer is one of the deadliest cancers, and first-line survival has barely improved in decades.
